extraction.notes: Used Quarter Ended September 30, 2023 column. Starting line is Net income (181,286); FFO subtotal is 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (376,575, after preferred distributions), and Core starts from it, so the Core total is 'Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (376,139). Preferred distributions (773) are categorized as 'other'. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (5,766) is categorized as 'other' because its nature is not specified on these pages. Diluted shares figure is 391,135 as printed on page 7 for the nine-month column? No: the printed quarter column for diluted weighted average shares is 391,351, which is the value used here for the quarter; the diluted count shown in the record as 391,135 is the nine-month figure and is NOT the quarter value. Check: 376,575 / 391,351 = 0.962 and 376,139 / 391,351 = 0.961, both consistent with reported $0.96. AFFO is not reported by EQR. No quarterly recurring capex is disclosed; the capital expenditures table on page 25 covers only the nine months ended September 30, 2023, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Net (gain) loss on sales of unconsolidated entities is nil for the quarter (shown as —), recorded as 0.
